additional_info.subject: RE: 0381251 - ID0381251-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P7 312547889/01] No transaction on charger CRM:02023000165
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope this message finds you well.
Upon reviewing the reported issue, we conducted an analysis of the logs and identified several anomalies. Specifically, we examined a few sessions where the charging process was aborted during the cable check phase. Two errors were observed: error code 67 and error code 38.
As per our understanding, error 67 indicates that the vehicle ended with an unexpected Pilot State B, while error 38 refers to an invalid parameter or wrong internal state. Despite this, we were unable to pinpoint the exact cause of the issue based on the SCB logs.
Further investigation of the error flags on SCB revealed the presence of
DC2_StateMonitor_KF13
. Based on this, we recommend scheduling a site visit to thoroughly troubleshoot and identify the root cause of the failure. Additionally, we advise carrying a spare
KF13 state monitor
and
QA35 contactor
, in case replacement is necessary during the intervention.
The same information has been communicated to Winckel Francois. Please inform him about the intervention plan so he can be available for support as discussed with him.
